title: Strategic Insights Analyst
description:
At Quantcast, we don't just build advertising technology, we revolutionize how it works. Our AI-powered Demand Side Platform (DSP) connects the world's most ambitious marketers with their ideal audiences across the open internet, delivering results that actually move the needle. Since 2006, we've been the industry's trailblazer, launching the first AI-powered measurement platform for publishers and the first AI-driven DSP. Our AI doesn't just optimize—it delivers the measurable outcomes that matter most to our clients, giving them the competitive edge they need in a crowded marketplace. Ready to join the team that's defining the future of digital advertising?

### **About the Role**

Quantcast is looking for a data-driven, commercially minded **Strategic Insights Analyst** to join our Insights team. In this role, you will work alongside some of the brightest talent in the digital advertising space, gaining direct exposure to high-stakes marketing challenges across multiple global markets and industries

You will bridge the gap between complex data analytics and client storytelling—equipping our global Sales and Account Management teams to bring deeper consultative value to every client conversation. By mining Quantcast’s proprietary first-party behavioral signals alongside syndicated third-party research, you will uncover shifting consumer journeys, identify untapped revenue opportunities, and craft compelling, pitch-ready narratives for our highest-value enterprise advertisers and agency partners worldwide.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **1PD & Third-Party Data Fusion:** Combine Quantcast’s proprietary audience signals with syndicated market research to build holistic industry snapshots, audience personas, and competitive displacement stories across priority verticals
* **Consumer Journey & Opportunity Discovery:** Proactively identify emerging consumer behaviors, shifting path-to-conversion patterns, and seasonal/tentpole media opportunities that help clients capture incremental demand.
* **Consultative Narrative & Pitch Storytelling:** Stitch together persuasive, client-ready narratives for new business, Joint Business Plans (JBPs)—translating raw behavioral and campaign data into clear business recommendations.
* **Scalable Data Extraction & Analytics:** Expert at **SQL, Snowflake, and Python** to size generate bespoke insights and also automate repeatable insight templates for self-serve sales enablement.
* **AI-Enabled Insight Generation:** Leverage modern data infrastructure, LLMs, and internal AI workflows to accelerate research synthesis, pattern detection, and insight packaging across regional sales teams.
* **Cross-Regional Pod Collaboration:** Partner closely with Account Directors, Product Marketing, and our Measurement Science team to turn complex analytical findings into modular slides

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** **5+ years** of hands-on experience in data analytics, audience insights, or commercial strategy within the **advertising, ad tech, media agency, or digital publishing industry**.
* **Technical Stack:** Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Snowflake** for large-scale data querying, paired with practical **Python** skills for data manipulation and workflow automation.
* **Data Storytelling:** Proven ability to synthesize complex, multi-source datasets (1PD, programmatic bidstream/behavioral data, and 3rd-party syndicated research) into concise, visually compelling executive slides.
* **Market Research Exposure:** Familiarity with quantitative and qualitative market research methodologies, brand/audience tracking, and syndicated tools (such as GWI, eMarketer, Comscore, or Nielsen).
* **AI & Modern Data Curiosity:** Hands-on comfort adopting evolving data tools and generative AI workflows to scale analytical output and uncover non-obvious consumer trends.
* **Commercial Mindset:** Strong understanding of digital advertising fundamentals (programmatic DSPs, upper- vs. lower-funnel KPIs, attribution, and media planning cycles) with the ability to communicate clearly with non-technical sales stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and building self-serve data assets for commercial teams.

At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location. On top of a competitive salary, this position includes a performance bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. For more details, visit our Careers Page and see how we support our team. We are headquartered in San Francisco with offices around the world. Quantcast is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please see the Applicant Privacy Notice for details on our applicant privacy policy. Join the team that unlocks potential.

title: Retail Pharmacist
description:
**Job Summary:**

HealthSy Pharmacy is seeking a highly professional, detail-oriented **Retail Pharmacist** to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately dispensing prescription medications, counseling patients on proper pharmaceutical usage and potential side effects, managing store inventory efficiently, and ensuring full compliance with healthcare regulations to deliver an exceptional patient-care experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prescription Handling & Dispensing:** Process prescriptions accurately, ensure safe dispensing of medicines, and guide customers on dosage and medication usage.
* **Patient Counseling:** Educate customers on medication usage, potential side effects, drug interactions, and appropriate therapeutic alternatives.
* **Customer Handling:** Provide exceptional service by greeting walk-in customers, addressing their healthcare inquiries, resolving grievances, and maintaining a welcoming store environment.
* **Stock Management:** Work closely with the SCM team to maintain appropriate stock levels and properly log all customer requests to support continuous stock availability.
* **Delivery Coordination:** Maintain delivery request records and follow up to ensure timely delivery of medicines.
* **Customer Support:** Handle inbound calls and customer queries related to medicines, prescriptions, and home delivery orders.
* **Customer Retention & Support:** Deliver complete customer care and support to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term retention.
* **Billing & Cash Handling:** Support counter billing and cash transactions whenever required.
* **Storage & Safety:** Ensure proper storage of medicines, including temperature-sensitive products, and maintain stock security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Follow applicable pharmacy regulations, licensing requirements, and HealthSy operational policies.
* **SOP & Policy Adherence:** Comply strictly with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and company policy for sheet handling, billing software usage, and transaction processing.
* **Inventory Verification & Inward Checks:** Perform thorough inward stock inspections by checking quantities, MRP, batch numbers, and expiry dates before updating stock entries in the system.
* **Regular Stock Audits & Expiry Monitoring:** Conduct bi-weekly physical stock counts across product categories, verify fast-moving items daily, and track product expiration to segregate near-expiry items and minimize stock wastage.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* B.Pharm / D.Pharm qualification.
* Valid State Pharmacy Council registration.
* 0–6 years of pharmacy experience (freshers can apply).
* Prior experience in a retail pharmacy setting is strongly preferred.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer-handling skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced retail pharmacy setting and oversee daily operations efficiently.
* Customer-centric mindset paired with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

**What you will get:**

* Competitive salary aligned with industry standards.
* Opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, dynamic healthcare organization.
* Performance-linked incentives as per company policy.
* Statutory benefits including PF and ESI compliance.
* Career development pathways and continuous learning opportunities.

**Compensation:**

**Salary range: ₹[18] to ₹[30k] per month**, based on experience and interview performance

**Plus:**

* Performance incentive linked to store sales, margin, and compliance targets
* PF, ESI (as applicable).
* Paid leave and weekly off as per company policy

**How to apply:**

* Ensure your qualifications align with the job description before applying.
* Send your resume with a relevant subject line to pravin.k@healthsy.in or careers@heathsypharmacy.com
* Call +91 8925828032 directly or share your resume via WhatsApp at the same number.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Hospital management system Support/ Implementation Analyst
description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on **HIMS Business & Implementation Analyst** to drive end-to-end implementation, workflow optimization, and ongoing client success for the **HIMS Platform**.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between clinical stakeholders and engineering teams. You will work directly with doctors, nurses, billers, and hospital administrators to translate complex operational needs into technical specifications, optimize clinical and administrative workflows, manage system rollouts, and ensure high user adoption.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Requirements Gathering & Workflow Optimization**

· Engage directly with healthcare staff (physicians, nursing, administrative, billing, and lab teams) to map clinical workflows and identify operational bottlenecks.

· Translate business and clinical requirements into technical specifications for the product and development teams.

· Propose tailored solutions using the HIMS Platform to streamline patient registration, appointment scheduling, billing, EHR management, and diagnostic machine integrations.

**2. End-to-End System Implementation**

· Lead the full system lifecycle—from pre-implementation setup and module configuration to data migration and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Perform system testing, master data imports, and pre-go-live readiness checks.

· Ensure strict alignment with national/regional healthcare standards and regulations (such as HIPAA).

**3. Customer Support & SLA Management**

* Act as the escalation point for incoming customer support requests, software troubleshooting, and operational inquiries.
* Manage helpdesk ticketing operations, prioritizing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and enforcing strict SLA resolution targets.
* Troubleshoot software bugs, database queries (SQL/MySQL), integration issues (biometric readers, lab analyzers, printers), and operational bottlenecks.
* Perform routine system health checks and coordinate regular software releases, feature updates, and patch deployments with client IT teams.

**4. Training, Change Management & Analytics**

* Design and execute tailored onboarding and training programs for both technical and non-technical healthcare personnel.
* Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), user manuals, and standardized pre-implementation questionnaires.
* Analyze clinical, financial, and operational data to deliver actionable performance insights (e.g., patient wait times, bed utilization, support ticket trends) to hospital leadership.

**Qualifications & Education**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or Bio-Medical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 3+ years of combined experience in HIS/HMS/EHR implementation, healthcare IT business analysis, and application technical support.

**Core Competencies & Technical Skills**

* **Domain & Operational Expertise:** In-depth knowledge of hospital operations (OPD, IPD, LIMS, RIS, HR/Payroll, Billing) and healthcare compliance.
* **Customer Support & Escalation Handling:** Proven track record in managing L2/L3 customer support, helpdesk ticketing tools, client SLAs, and customer retention strategies.
* **Technical & Database Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with SQL/relational databases, data migration, machine-to-software integrations, and biometric hardware setup.
* **Communication & Conflict Resolution:** High empathy and clear communication skills to effectively interface with hospital executives, doctors, and non-technical support staff under high-pressure scenarios.

**Interview Evaluation Criteria**

**Evaluation Pillar**

**Focus Areas & Key Competencies**

**1. Healthcare Operations & Workflows**

OPD/IPD flows, revenue cycle management, LIMS/RIS processes, hardware integrations, and regulatory standards.

**2. Implementation & Technical Analysis**

Requirements gathering, UAT management, SQL database queries, data migration logic, and technical gap analysis.

**3. Customer Support & SLA Operations**

Incident classification, root cause analysis, helpdesk management, SLA enforcement, and handling disgruntled clients during critical system outages.

**4. Communication & Leadership**

Executive reporting, change management, training non-technical clinical staff, and cross-functional team coordination.

title: Lead Architect, IoT Cloud Platform
description:
*Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world have helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes, Corporate Knights and others.*

  

*KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embedding sustainability even deeper across our operations.*

  

KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem

  
  

**Role purpose**

We are seeking a **Lead Architect** to define and govern the **end-to-end architecture** of our **global industrial IoT** and **digital platform ecosystem** .

  
  

The role connects physical equipment, gateway runtimes, device connectivity, cloud platforms, digital applications, enterprise identity, and AI-enabled capabilities into a coherent, evolvable architecture.

  
  

The architect will establish architecture-first delivery practices in which business capabilities, quality attributes, system boundaries, contracts, security requirements, and operational models are defined before implementation.

  
  

You will translate complex technical decisions into clear recommendations for engineering and business stakeholders, connecting choices to customer value, cost, risk, reliability, delivery timelines, and operational readiness.

  
  

**What you will do**

* Own target architectures, system boundaries, contracts, quality requirements, and technical roadmaps. Document alternatives, assumptions, failure modes, and trade-offs before implementation.

* Design multi-region routing, tenant and workload isolation, data placement, replication, failover and failback. Define RTO, RPO, availability objectives, and recovery validation for each workload.

* Enable repeatable regional expansion through reusable infrastructure, automated onboarding, configuration-driven deployment, and application designs that avoid regional forks.

* Govern industrial edge connectivity, device provisioning, certificate lifecycle, offline behavior, secure OTA updates, and command handling with embedded and safety specialists.

* Architect cloud services, APIs, real-time integrations, messaging, and data platforms with explicit ownership, compatibility, tenant isolation, and failure behavior.

* Embed security, observability, capacity planning, cost management, upgrade paths, and operational readiness into every architecture.

* Establish practical architecture standards, ADRs, reusable platform capabilities, repository boundaries, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery checks.

* Communicate through clear diagrams, business-focused narratives, and decision options. Lead cross-team reviews, mentor engineers, and build trust with stakeholders.

* Evaluate AI-assisted engineering and AI-enabled applications with specialist teams, considering business value, privacy, permissions, security, limitations, evaluation, and human oversight.

  
  

**PKI, device identity, and cryptographic architecture**

**Architecture focus:** PKI is a foundational device trust system, not merely a subtopic within general identity and security. The role must govern identity from factory provisioning through operational use, renewal, revocation, retirement, and long-lived hardware replacement.

* Define hardware-backed device identity using IEEE 802.1AR concepts, including factory identity and operational identity, with TPM 2.0 or secure-element roots of trust.

* Design zero-touch enrollment and renewal using appropriate protocols such as EST, SCEP, or CMPv2, with explicit bootstrap, recovery, renewal, revocation, and offline behavior.

* Author X.509 certificate profiles aligned with RFC 5280, including subject naming, SAN conventions, EKU constraints, key usage, validity periods, policy OIDs, CRL distribution points, and validation rules.

* Design CA hierarchies, trust domains, signing boundaries, key ceremonies, offline root protection, intermediate CA operations, HSM integration, and delegated issuance.

* Govern certificate rotation at fleet scale, including clock drift, intermittent connectivity, dual-certificate overlap, compromised-device recovery, factory reset, ownership transfer, and end-of-life handling.

* Define cryptographic agility and long-term migration strategies for algorithm changes, including assessment of post-quantum standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA where appropriate.

  
  

**Standards, RFCs, and normative specifications**

Establish a reference architecture and standards catalogue that distinguishes mandatory requirements from recommendations. Use RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 terminology consistently when writing normative specifications.

* Use MUST and MUST NOT for binding requirements; use SHOULD and SHOULD NOT for strong recommendations with documented exceptions; use MAY for permitted options.

* Maintain versioned specifications for identity, certificate profiles, TLS, MQTT topics, API contracts, event schemas, command semantics, error handling, and regional deployment.

* Reference applicable standards such as RFC 5280 for X.509 certificates, RFC 7030 for EST, RFC 8446 for TLS 1.3, RFC 6455 for WebSockets, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect specifications, OpenAPI, and the OASIS MQTT specification.

* Use ADRs to record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security impact, operational impact, and conditions for revisiting the decision.

* Keep C4, deployment, sequence, threat, and data-flow models versioned with the systems they describe.

  
  

**Required experience**

* 14+ years in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or systems architecture, including 6+ years leading architecture for complex enterprise, industrial, or mission-critical systems.

* Proven production delivery and operational experience with multi-region systems, disaster recovery, incident response, and recovery validation.

* Strong system design judgment and hands-on ability to validate decisions through prototypes, code reviews, performance testing, load testing, and operational evidence.

* Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience creating standards and governance that enable delivery rather than introducing unnecessary process.

  
  

**Preferred experience**

* Industrial equipment, fleet management, OT cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, digital twins, or large-scale multi-tenant platforms.

* Platform engineering, technology modernization, and practical exposure to AI-assisted development or enterprise AI integration.

* Experience with long-lived devices, constrained connectivity, safety-related command paths, and supplier or partner integration.

  
  

**Certifications**

Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. They do not replace demonstrated system design expertise and production experience.

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Security – Specialty.

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist.

* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture qualification.

* Relevant Microsoft identity, security, industrial cybersecurity, or cryptography certifications.

  
  

**What success looks like**

* Architecture decisions are clear, trusted, documented, and adopted by delivery teams.

* Multi-region applications meet agreed availability, RTO, and RPO objectives, with recovery regularly tested.

* Device identity and PKI operations are automated, observable, recoverable, and secure throughout the asset lifecycle.

* Platforms remain secure, operable, and maintainable as devices, tenants, integrations, and capabilities grow.

* Normative standards and reusable platform capabilities reduce duplication, incompatible changes, and operational toil.

* AI experimentation is practical, governed, privacy-aware, and separated from unsafe or unverified control of physical equipment.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Oracle EBS R12.2 architecture, Oracle Database administration, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud migrations, and enterprise application support. The candidate will be responsible for leading complex EBS projects, driving architecture decisions, mentoring junior team members, managing mission-critical production environments, and ensuring the stability, security, and performance of Oracle EBS ecosystems deployed on-premises and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). \*\*\* # Key Responsibilities ## Oracle EBS Architecture & Administration \* Lead the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of Oracle EBS R12.2 environments. \* Architect and support complex multi-node EBS deployments across Production, DR, UAT, and Development environments. \* Perform and lead EBS upgrades, migrations, platform migrations, and technology stack upgrades. \* Manage EBS application lifecycle activities, including cloning, patching, maintenance, and refresh activities. \* Administer and troubleshoot ADOP Online Patching cycles and EBS shared application tier architectures. \* Support integrations with Oracle Fusion, OIC, third-party applications, SSO, LDAP, and Identity Management solutions. ## Database Administration & High Availability \* Administer Oracle Databases (19c, 23ai, 26ai) supporting Oracle EBS environments. \* Design and implement Oracle RAC, Data Guard, Active Data Guard, and Disaster Recovery solutions. \* Lead database upgrade, patching, backup, recovery, and migration activities. \* Develop database capacity planning and performance optimization strategies. \* Ensure database security, compliance, and operational efficiency. ## Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting \* Lead proactive performance tuning initiatives across application, middleware, database, storage, and network layers. \* Perform advanced performance analysis using: \* AWR \* ASH \* ADDM \* TKPROF \* SQL Trace \* OEM Performance Hub \* Tune complex SQL queries, database parameters, concurrent processing, and EBS workflows. \* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks affecting: \* Oracle Forms \* Reports \* Workflow Mailers \* XML Publisher \* WebLogic Services \* Concurrent Processing \* Database Workloads \* Conduct root cause analysis for critical production issues and recurring incidents. ## Cloud & Migration Projects \* Lead Oracle EBS migrations to OCI, Exadata Cloud Service, and Autonomous Database platforms. \* Architect cloud-ready EBS solutions with High Availability and Disaster Recovery capabilities. \* Plan and execute cross-platform migrations, database consolidations, and infrastructure modernization projects. \* Work closely with cloud, network, security, and application teams during cloud transformation initiatives. ## Security & Compliance \* Implement Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPU), Security Patches, and Compliance Controls. \* Manage SSL/TLS certificates and secure communication channels. \* Ensure adherence to audit, governance, and regulatory compliance requirements. \* Review and harden EBS and database environments against security vulnerabilities. ## Middleware & Infrastructure Management \* Administer and troubleshoot: \* Oracle WebLogic Server \* Oracle HTTP Server (OHS) \* Load Balancers \* DMZ Architectures \* PCP (Parallel Concurrent Processing) \* SSO/OAM/OID Integrations \* Support enterprise-scale HA and DR architectures across multiple regions and data centers. \* Collaborate with infrastructure teams

title: Software Principal Engineer - System Test & Customer Solutions Validation
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – System Test & Customer Solutions Validation (SONiC AI & Enterprise Networking)**

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for enabling customer adoption of SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, from POCs and deployment validation to complex escalations. You will work with customers, support, pre-sales, solution architects, and engineering teams on fabric orchestration, deployment readiness, and resolution of customer issues. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, customer-focused engineer who bridges customers and engineering, resolves critical issues, and accelerates adoption of reliable, scalable, customer-ready SONiC-based networking and AI fabric solutions.

**You will:**

* Serve as the first line of escalation into engineering for support and pre-sales, troubleshooting customer issues and driving workarounds and planned resolutions.
* Define and drive system-level validation strategies for complex SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, aligned with spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD), validating customer use cases, POCs, and end-to-end workflows across network infrastructure, fabric orchestration, servers, storage, and telemetry.
* Investigate complex customer-reported issues across SONiC software, networking protocols, platform components, and orchestration systems, including link-level errors and retransmit behavior, closing field escapes through triage, debugging, and closure.
* Provide technical leadership across customer engineering, system test, product management, and software development organizations.
* Drive architectural reviews, identify solution gaps, and influence product engineering roadmaps based on customer deployment requirements, translating customer feedback and field learnings into engineering improvements using Python, SpyTest automation, and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Customer and solution experience: working with customers, solution architects, support, and engineering teams on POCs, deployments, and escalations, and system testing complex AI, data center, and enterprise networks, including scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, rack-scale, and fabric-scale environments.
* Networking technologies: VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, VRF, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, BFD, Layer 2, multicast, RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, and enterprise services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* Integrated solutions: validation of networking, compute, storage, GPU cluster, and fabric orchestration solutions, including Ansible, Kubernetes integrations, and lifecycle workflows.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with telemetry and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG), traffic generator testing (for example IXIA), and packet analysis.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with SONiC and SpyTest, network test automation, deployment validation, and customer-focused solution demonstrations.
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for troubleshooting, solution analysis, automation, and customer issue investigation.

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here .

The Hygiene and Food Safety Manager is responsible for overseeing, maintaining, and enforcing the highest standards of food safety, sanitation, and personal hygiene across all restaurant kitchens, storage areas, service stations, and back-of-house operations. This role ensures full compliance with local health codes, regulatory bodies (such as FSSAI in India), and internal brand quality standards to protect guests and staff from foodborne risks.

Key Responsibilities

 Regulatory & Brand Compliance:

o Enforce local food safety laws, licensing codes, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

o Maintain Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) systems and keep comprehensive digital or physical safety logs.

o Inspect kitchen equipment cleanliness and report mechanical or structural defects that compromise sanitation.

 Incident & Risk Management:

o Investigate any customer or staff complaints related to food quality, foreign objects, or illness.

o Bachelor’s degree or 2-year diploma in Food Science, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Environmental Health, or a related field.

 Certifications:

o Certified in HACCP, Good Hygiene Practices (GHPs), and local food safety authority certifications (e.g., FSSAI/FOSTAC).

 Experience:

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
**SUMMARY**

As a Software Principal Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end engineering of Dell networking products and solutions for data center and AI fabric environments, driving innovation in a fast-paced development environment from requirements definition and architecture through development, validation, release, and customer deployment.

You will collaborate with platform, silicon, software, validation, solutions, and customer-facing teams to deliver next-generation Dell Enterprise SONiC capabilities for the high-performance network fabrics powering the Dell AI Factory. You will also apply AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and enhance engineering productivity.

**You will:**

* Own complex networking features end to end, from requirements and architecture through validation and delivery of production-quality Dell Enterprise SONiC software.
* Architect and deliver large-scale data center and AI fabric capabilities on Dell PowerSwitch (800GbE/1.6TbE) platforms, including RoCEv2, congestion management, adaptive routing, SRv6, and dynamic load balancing.
* Troubleshoot complex system, scalability, performance, and customer issues across the control plane, data plane, SAI, and switch ASIC layers.
* Drive fabric automation and lifecycle management using REST APIs, gNMI/OpenConfig, YANG, Python, Ansible, ONIE, and ZTP, and apply Dell AI tools to speed development, testing, and debugging.
* Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and work with global hardware, silicon, quality, product, and customer-facing teams to deliver reliable releases.

-------------------------------------------------

title: Architect

* Partner with quality engineering experts to define test strategies performance benchmarks and validation approaches that ensure high quality releases in day shift operations
* Support deployment and configuration of applications across hybrid environments by defining environment specific parameters monitoring strategies and rollback approaches

**Department:** Admissions  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 2 Years  
**Job Location:** Dr. M.G.R. Nagar, Perandapalli, Tamil Nadu – 635130

About the Institution

Adhiyamaan College of Engineering is an engineering education institution committed to academic excellence and student development. We aim to help students identify suitable academic programmes and make informed decisions about their higher education and career opportunities.

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Education Counsellor to join our Admissions Team and support student recruitment and admission activities.

Job Summary

The Education Counsellor will be responsible for handling student enquiries, counselling students and parents regarding engineering and other academic programmes, explaining admission procedures, and converting prospective student enquiries into confirmed admissions. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a professional approach, and experience in educational counselling or college admissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle student and parent enquiries through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, website enquiries, and walk-in visits.
* Explain available courses, specializations, eligibility criteria, fee structures, scholarships (where applicable), and admission procedures.
* Counsel students and parents regarding engineering programmes, higher education opportunities, and career prospects.
* Follow up with prospective students regularly to encourage applications and improve admission conversion rates.
* Manage and update student enquiry databases using CRM software, MS Excel, or admission management systems.
* Assist students with application forms, document submission, eligibility verification, and admission formalities.
* Coordinate with the Admissions Department and other relevant departments to ensure a smooth admission process.
* Communicate professionally with students, parents, educational consultants, and school representatives.
* Support admission campaigns, school visits, career guidance programmes, education fairs, seminars, and promotional events.
* Maintain accurate records of enquiries, follow-ups, applications, and confirmed admissions.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission performance reports for the reporting manager.
* Work towards individual and team admission targets within the prescribed timelines.
* Provide timely updates to students regarding application status, required documents, and admission deadlines.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of student information and admission records.

Eligibility Criteria

* Any undergraduate degree from a recognized university.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in education counselling, student admissions, or a related field.
* Experience in engineering college admissions or higher education counselling will be an added advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Tamil and English is preferred.
* Basic computer skills, including MS Excel, email, and online enquiry management.
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries, conduct consistent follow-ups, and work towards admission targets.

Required Skills

* Student counselling and parent communication
* Engineering college admission procedures
* Lead management and enquiry conversion
* Telephone, WhatsApp, and email communication
* CRM and admission database management
* MS Excel and report preparation
* Student relationship management
* Time management and organizational skills
* Team coordination and problem-solving
* Target-oriented working approach

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, student-focused, and capable of building positive relationships with students and parents. Candidates with previous experience in engineering colleges, universities, educational institutions, admission offices, or education consultancy firms are encouraged to apply.

Salary and Benefits

* Salary: As per experience and institutional norms.
* Employment Type: Full-Time.
* Opportunity to work with the college admissions team.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.

Work Location

Tamil Nadu – 635130.

**Position:** Front Office Receptionist  
**Reports to:** Reservation Manager  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Hotel Mahabs, Tamil Nadu, India

Job Summary

The Front Office Receptionist is the first point of contact for our guests. You will manage check-ins and check-outs, handle reservation enquiries and bookings (direct, phone, mail and OTA), and make sure every guest has a warm, smooth and accurate experience from arrival to departure.

Key Responsibilities

**Guest Reception & Service**

* Greet guests warmly and complete check-in and check-out efficiently
* Verify guest ID and fill registration details accurately
* Explain room category, occupancy (1 Pax / 2 Pax), amenities, and hotel facilities, including restaurant access and the free swimming pool
* Inform guests clearly about the property layout (no lift; rooms on upper floors) and arrange luggage assistance
* Handle guest requests, feedback, and complaints politely and escalate when needed

**Reservations & Enquiries**

* Answer phone, walk-in, WhatsApp and email enquiries professionally
* Record every enquiry and booking as a lead (New / Follow-up) in the hotel’s lead form or enquiry sheet, and follow up on pending leads
* Share each booking and lead details to the hotel WhatsApp group promptly
* Quote correct room rates, taxes, and add-on charges (taxi, early check-in, late check-out)
* Check availability on the daily room allotment chart before confirming bookings
* Coordinate with the reservation manager on OTA bookings (MMT, Booking.com, Agoda, Cleartrip, Yatra, Expedia), including guest arrival details and special requests

**Billing & Records**

* Prepare accurate guest bills and invoices, including company/GST invoices when requested
* Collect payments (cash, UPI, card), and maintain shift-wise cash and payment records
* Submit a daily shift report and hand over pending tasks to the next shift

**Coordination**

* Communicate room status with housekeeping and update room allotment in real time
* Coordinate with restaurant, maintenance, and management for guest needs
* Maintain confidentiality of guest and hotel information

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Degree/diploma in Hotel Management or any graduate (freshers with good aptitude may apply)
* 0-2 years of front office or hospitality experience preferred
* Fluent in Tamil and English; Hindi is an added advantage
* Good communication, grooming, and customer-handling skills
* Basic computer skills: MS Excel, email, WhatsApp Business; knowledge of a hotel PMS is a plus
* Accuracy in handling cash, billing, and data entry
* Ability to stay calm under pressure and work rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays

Personal Attributes

Courteous, punctual, honest, well-groomed, a team player, and quick to take ownership of guest issues.

What We Offer

* Salary as per experience and industry standards
* Training in front office operations and OTA reservations
* Growth opportunities within the hotel

title: CNC Setter
description:
Job posting: CNC Turning Center Setter / Programmer

**​Position: CNC Turning Center Setter / Operator ​Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu (SIPCOT-1 / Industrial Area)**

​Employment Type: Full-Time ​Experience Required: 0 to 5 Years ​Salary Range: ₹27,000 to ₹34,000 per month (Commensurate with experience) + Performance Incentives & Perks

​About the Role ​We are looking for an experienced and skilled CNC Turning Center Setter to join our precision manufacturing and machining shop floor in Hosur. In this role, you will be responsible for independent machine setup, tooling selection, program loading/editing (Fanuc controls), and ensuring strict adherence to engineering tolerances and component quality.

**​Key Responsibilities** **​**

**Machine Setup & Tooling**: Perform independent setups on CNC Turning Centers, including loading raw materials, securing workpieces, installing fixtures, and setting up tooling. **​**

**Offset & Calibration**: Execute precise tool offsets, work offsets, and coordinate measurement checks to ensure exact dimensional accuracy. **​**

**Programming & Editing**: Read and interpret complex 2D/3D engineering drawings, GD&T symbols, and make necessary manual data input (MDI) or program edits (Fanuc controller preferred). **​**

**Quality Assurance**: Conduct rigorous in-process quality inspections using precision measuring instruments (Vernier calipers, micrometers, height gauges, bore gauges) to ensure zero-defect production. **​**

**Process Optimization**: Monitor cutting parameters (feed, speed, depth of cut) to optimize cycle times, minimize scrap, and improve tool life. **​**

**Routine Maintenance**: Perform daily preventive maintenance, check coolant/lubrication levels, and keep the machine and work area clean. ​Safety & Compliance: Strictly adhere to shop floor safety protocols, PPE requirements, and company manufacturing standards. ​

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications ​Education: ITI (Machinist / Turner) / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical technical training. ​

Experience: Minimum 0–5 years of hands-on shop-floor experience exclusively on CNC Turning Centers (2-axis / 3-axis or twin-turret setups). ​

Technical Skills: ​Strong expertise in reading engineering blueprints and process route cards. ​Proficiency in Fanuc control systems and program editing. ​Sound knowledge of cutting tool grades, inserts, and speeds/feeds for various engineering materials (alloy steels, aluminum, brass, etc.). ​Work Ethic: High attention to detail, safety-conscious, punctual, and capable of working in shift rotations if required.

​Salary, Perks & Benefits ​Competitive Base Salary: ₹27,000 – ₹34,000 per month (negotiable based on skill level). ​Statutory Benefits: Provident Fund (PF) and ESI coverage. ​Daily Perks: Subsidized or free factory meals / Canteen facility provided on-site. ​Performance Bonuses: Attendance bonuses and monthly production incentive schemes. ​

**Growth Opportunities**: Clear career path towards Production Supervisor, Lead Programmer, or Shop Floor In-Charge. ​

**How to Apply** ​Interested candidates can share their updated resume via WhatsApp or email, or walk in directly for an interview and machine test. ​

Contact Number / WhatsApp: [7904116273] ​Email: the.victors.co@gmail.com

You will provide hands-on expertise in z/OS system administration, including system maintenance, upgrades, software installations, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution. Success in this role is measured by platform stability, timely incident resolution, successful implementation of changes and upgrades, strong technical ownership, effective customer engagement, and high levels of customer satisfaction.

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. description:
***JOB DESCRIPTION***

**Overall purpose:**

Join our dynamic team at Regent College London as a Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Engineer (Integrations, ALM & Security), where you'll help evolve and harden our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform services that support key Higher Education business processes (admissions, marketing, enrolment, student communications and student support).

In this role you'll design and deliver solutions across Dataverse (model-driven apps), Canvas apps, Power Automate and Power Pages. You'll bring strong engineering capability in API integrations and pro-code extensibility (e.g., plugins, JavaScript) and will help establish secure, reliable delivery practices across environments.

This role is based remotely (India), joining a UK-based function and working primarily to the UK time zone. You'll be part of a small, dedicated team delivering both strategic initiatives and continuous improvements.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter and strong individual contributor, comfortable owning work end-to-end without a dedicated QA team. You will also act as a technical multiplier by uplifting integration patterns, ALM/CI-CD, and security practices, and by mentoring other developers as they upskill.

Specific duties and responsibilities:

· Design, build and enhance Dataverse-based solutions (model-driven apps, tables, forms, views and business logic) aligned to the CRM product roadmap.

· Support day-to-day Dynamics 365/Dataverse configuration including adding fields, modifying forms/views, business rules, security roles, and general entity/app administration as part of shared team responsibilities.

· Design and build targeted Canvas apps (and reusable components where appropriate) for business scenarios that are better served by task-focused, UX-first experiences, integrating with Dataverse and other services.

· Implement custom logic where required using C# (plugins and/or custom workflow activities), JavaScript/TypeScript, and platform extensibility patterns.

· Design, develop and support API-based integrations between Dynamics 365/Dataverse and enterprise systems (including the Student Records System where applicable) using REST APIs, OAuth2/Entra ID, custom connectors and/or Azure integration services.

· Create, enhance and refactor Power Automate flows using resilient engineering practices (error handling, retries, logging, idempotency where relevant, connection references and environment variables).

· Contribute to the migration from legacy ADX/portal capabilities to Power Pages, including page/templates, forms, security/permissions, and safe integration patterns back to Dataverse and other services.

· Maintain disciplined solution management and automated deployments across environments using Azure DevOps (Power Platform Build Tools/PAC CLI), including versioning, release notes and deployment runbooks.

· Improve the security posture of the platform through least-privilege role design, team/access model reviews, auditing, and Power Pages permission modelling; collaborate with platform/tenant administrators on governance controls.

· Perform thorough testing, create reusable test scripts/checklists, and participate in peer reviews to ensure quality, performance and reliability.

· Triage and resolve defects/incidents promptly, provide third-line support for integrations/automations, and proactively monitor and improve platform health.

· Work closely with the Head of Enterprise Applications & CRM, Project Manager, developers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, propose options, communicate trade-offs and maintain clear technical documentation.

Additional duties

· Contribute to consistent Agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, review and retrospectives) and support lightweight estimation and delivery forecasting for a small team.

· Help implement and document engineering standards (ALM, CI/CD, integration patterns, security reviews) and contribute to Centre of Excellence (CoE) practices where appropriate.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION**

EXPERIENCE & PERSONAL QUALITIES

Essential

· Full proficiency in English; confident communicating with UK-based stakeholders. Ability to work effectively as part of a small delivery team and collaborate across IT and business functions.

· 3-5 years of experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and the Power Platform.

· Hands-on experience with Dataverse solution delivery (tables, forms, views, business rules/processes) in model-driven apps; able to contribute to Canvas apps where appropriate.

· Comfortable delivering both configuration-level enhancements (e.g., fields, forms, views, business rules) and engineering-level work (integrations, ALM/CI/CD, security).

· Experience designing and building Power Apps Canvas apps (responsive design, components and Dataverse integration).

· Experience delivering Power Pages (or ADX Studio Portals), including external user journeys and permissions modelling.

· Experience building and supporting API integrations (REST, OAuth2/Entra ID app registrations) and using tools such as Postman.

· Experience with pro-code extensibility for Dataverse (e.g., C# plugins/custom workflow activities) and/or client-side scripting (JavaScript).

· Strong Power Automate experience, including production-grade practices (error handling, monitoring and supportability).

· Experience working with Dev/UAT/Production environments and change/release management.

· Comfortable working independently without a dedicated QA team; able to plan, test and deliver end-to-end.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with attention to security and data integrity..

Desirable

· Experience with Azure integration services (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault).

· Experience implementing CI/CD for Power Platform using Azure DevOps pipelines (Power Platform Build Tools and/or PAC CLI).

· Experience with PCF controls and TypeScript.

· Experience in Higher Education or similarly regulated environments handling sensitive personal data.

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE & SKILLSEssential

· Strong knowledge of Dataverse architecture, solution management (managed/unmanaged), and environment configuration (Dev/UAT/Prod).

· Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE/model-driven app configuration.

· C#/.NET experience for Dataverse plugins and related development practices (source control, code review, debugging).

Desirable

· Data export and reporting patterns (e.g., datalake concepts, ETL, Power BI modelling fundamentals).

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. **Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe z/OS System Administrator at Kyndryl, you will manage and support IBM z/OS environments that run mission-critical enterprise workloads for some of the world's largest organizations. You will be responsible for system installation, configuration, maintenance, performance tuning, problem determination, and modernization initiatives. Working closely with infrastructure, storage, security, and application teams, you will ensure the stability, availability, and security of the mainframe platform while driving operational excellence and automation.

  

**What You Will DO**

  

* Manage and administer IBM z/OS systems and associated software products.
* Perform z/OS installations, upgrades, maintenance, and customization activities.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability to ensure optimal operations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve operating system, hardware, and software issues.
* Administer JES2/JES3, TSO/ISPF, SMP/E, HCD, and system utilities.
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing, backup, and business continuity activities.
* Collaborate with application, storage, network, and security teams on infrastructure projects.
Support mainframe modernization and technology transformation initiatives.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**

description:
1. Job Purpose

The Guest Relations Officer for VIP is responsible for providing personalized, premium-level assistance and hospitality services to VIP patients, their families, and special guests during their hospital stay.

The officer acts as the primary point of contact between VIP patients and hospital departments, ensuring a smooth, comfortable, and satisfactory patient experience while maintaining confidentiality, professionalism, and high standards of service.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. VIP Patient and Guest Assistance

* Welcome VIP patients and their attendants with courtesy and professionalism.
* Personally attend to VIP patients during admission, room allocation, transfer, and discharge.
* Conduct regular rounds of VIP rooms and floors to check patient and attendant satisfaction.
* Ensure VIP patients receive prompt assistance for their requests and concerns.
* Coordinate special arrangements for VIP guests, including room amenities and hospitality requirements.
* Maintain a professional and approachable relationship with patients and their families.

B. Patient Coordination and Support

* Act as a single point of contact for VIP patients and their families.
* Coordinate with doctors, nursing teams, billing, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, housekeeping, security, and other departments.
* Facilitate timely communication regarding appointments, investigations, procedures, and discharge formalities.
* Follow up on pending patient requests and ensure timely resolution.
* Assist patients and attendants in navigating hospital services.

C. Room and Floor Management

* Conduct routine inspections of VIP rooms to ensure cleanliness, comfort, and readiness.
* Coordinate with housekeeping to maintain premium room standards.
* Ensure availability of toiletries, drinking water, linen, and other approved room amenities.
* Monitor room temperature, lighting, television, call bell, and other facilities.
* Immediately report maintenance issues and ensure timely rectification.
* Maintain a peaceful, safe, and comfortable environment on the VIP floor.

D. Complaint and Grievance Management

* Listen to patient and attendant concerns patiently and professionally.
* Resolve service-related complaints within the scope of authority.
* Escalate clinical concerns and medical emergencies immediately to the appropriate clinical team.
* Coordinate with concerned departments for timely complaint resolution.
* Maintain proper documentation of complaints, actions taken, and closure status.
* Conduct follow-up to ensure patient satisfaction after issue resolution.

E. Hospitality and Service Excellence

* Ensure personalized attention and premium hospitality for VIP patients.
* Coordinate approved food and beverage requests with the dietary department.
* Assist with visitor management and provide information about hospital facilities.
* Ensure courteous communication and professional conduct among service staff.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, etiquette, and patient interaction.

F. Documentation and Reporting

* Maintain daily VIP patient visit and interaction records.
* Maintain VIP patient feedback and complaint registers.
* Prepare daily floor activity reports.
* Monitor pending requests and follow up until closure.
* Report recurring service issues to the Guest Relations Manager.
* Maintain strict patient privacy and confidentiality.

3. Daily Routine Responsibilities

Frequency & Responsibility in Morning to Check VIP room readiness and patient requirements

Every shift Conduct VIP floor rounds

As required Coordinate with patient and attendant requests

Follow up on pending complaints and services

Before discharge, Coordinate discharge experience and feedback at End of shift

Submit handover and daily activity report

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* VIP patient satisfaction score.
* Number of VIP floor rounds completed.
* Complaint resolution time.
* Percentage of complaints closed within the defined timeline.
* VIP room readiness and housekeeping compliance.
* Patient and attendant feedback.
* Timely coordination of patient requests.
* Documentation and reporting accuracy.

5. Qualifications and Skills

Educational Qualification:

* Graduate in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Hospitality Management, or any relevant discipline.
* Diploma or certification in hospitality or patient relations is an added advantage.

Experience:

* 1–3 years of experience in hospital guest relations, front office, patient relations, or hospitality services.
* Experience in handling VIP patients or premium hospitality services is preferred.

Required Skills:

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Problem-solving and complaint-handling abilities.
* Good coordination and time-management skills.
* Professional grooming and positive attitude.
* Ability to handle sensitive situations diplomatically.
* Basic computer and MS Office knowledge.
* Strong confidentiality and patient service orientation.

6. Authority and Escalation

The Guest Relations Officer for VIP Floor is authorized to:

* Coordinate with all relevant hospital departments.
* Follow up on pending patient requests.
* Escalate service-related issues to the Guest Relations Manager.
* Report room maintenance and housekeeping deficiencies.
* Recommend service improvements.

The officer must not provide medical advice, change treatment plans, make clinical decisions, or promise clinical outcomes.

7. Expected Behaviour and Professional Standards

* Maintain 100% patient confidentiality.
* Demonstrate empathy, patience, and respect.
* Maintain professional grooming and etiquette.
* Never argue with patients or attendants.
* Avoid making unauthorized commitments.
* Ensure prompt communication and proper handover between shifts.
* Treat every VIP patient and family member with dignity and respect.

You will ensure the reliability, availability, and compliance of backup services while supporting restore requests, incident resolution, capacity management, and continuous improvement initiatives across enterprise infrastructure environments.

* Support onboarding and offboarding of backup clients, including agent deployment, prerequisite validation, backup configuration, and verification activities.
* Participate in incident, problem, and change management processes, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Perform routine platform health checks, capacity monitoring, housekeeping activities, and maintenance of operational documentation.
* Ensure compliance with backup retention policies, audit requirements, governance standards, and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with infrastructure, application, storage, security, and operations teams to maintain service reliability and improve backup operational efficiency.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in enterprise backup and recovery operations, with strong hands-on experience administering Commvault Backup & Recovery environments.
* Proven experience managing Commvault policies, schedules, storage policies, client configurations, backup operations, and recovery processes.
* Strong understanding of backup and disaster recovery concepts, including RPO, RTO, retention policies, incremental backups, synthetic full backups, and deduplication.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server environments and their backup and recovery requirements.
* Experience performing backup monitoring, troubleshooting, incident management, restore validation, and operational support activities.
* Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure environments, including storage platforms, virtualization technologies, and application backup requirements.
* Experience working within ITIL-based service management frameworks, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in production support and on-call environments.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise Commvault environments across distributed infrastructures.
* Knowledge of virtualized environments such as VMware and Hyper-V, including backup and recovery operations.
* Exposure to cloud-based backup solutions and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with backup reporting, automation, capacity planning, and operational process improvements.
Relevant Commvault, backup, infrastructure, or ITIL certifications preferred.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. description:
We are seeking a dynamic, articulate, and highly persuasive **Admission Counsellor** to serve as the primary brand ambassador for our school. The ideal candidate will be responsible for guiding prospective parents and students through the CBSE admission process, presenting the school’s academic philosophy and infrastructure compellingly, and achieving target enrollment goals.

**Key Responsibilities**1. Inquiries & Parent Interaction

* Serve as the face of the school for prospective parents, offering a warm, professional, and confident first impression.
* Handle inbound phone inquiries, walk-ins, email queries, and website leads promptly and effectively.
* Conduct detailed, engaging campus tours that showcase the school’s academic offerings, CBSE curriculum highlights, safety standards, facilities, and co-curricular programs.

description:
**1. Purchase Executive – College Cafeteria**

**Department:** Purchase  
**Designation:** Purchase Executive  
**Reporting To:** Cafeteria Manager / Purchase Manager / Administration Manager  
**Work Location:** College Campus

To manage the procurement of food ingredients, groceries, vegetables, dairy products, beverages, kitchen consumables, and cleaning materials for the college cafeteria. The Purchase Executive must ensure timely availability of materials, competitive pricing, consistent quality, proper documentation, and cost-effective purchasing in accordance with college policies.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Purchase Planning**

* Collect daily, weekly, and monthly material requirements from the cafeteria kitchen and store.
* Verify existing stock before initiating purchases.
* Prepare purchase requisitions and procurement schedules.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential ingredients and supplies.

**B. Supplier Management**

* Identify and maintain a list of approved suppliers.
* Obtain quotations from multiple vendors wherever required by college policy.
* Compare prices, quality, delivery schedules, and payment terms.
* Negotiate competitive rates and maintain good supplier relationships.
* Review supplier performance and recommend suitable alternatives.

**C. Purchase Order Management**

* Prepare purchase orders based on approved requirements.
* Obtain authorization before placing orders.
* Ensure that purchases remain within the approved budget and delegated authority.
* Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.

**D. Quality and Delivery Control**

* Coordinate with the storekeeper and kitchen team to inspect delivered materials.
* Check quantity, weight, freshness, packaging, quality, and expiry dates where applicable.
* Ensure appropriate handling and temperature control for perishable food items.
* Arrange replacement or return of damaged, substandard, or incorrect supplies.
* Maintain traceability and relevant food-safety documentation.

**E. Invoice and Documentation Management**

* Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders and goods received records.
* Maintain purchase registers, quotation files, approved vendor lists, and purchase orders.
* Submit verified bills to the accounts department for payment processing.
* Report discrepancies, duplicate invoices, and unauthorized purchases.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly purchase statements.

**G. Cost Control and Reporting**

* Monitor changes in market prices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Track expenditure against the approved cafeteria purchase budget.
* Prepare monthly item-wise and supplier-wise purchase summaries.
* Report significant price variations, supply shortages, and quality issues to management.
* Recommend improvements in purchasing procedures.

**3. Qualifications and Experience**

* **Educational qualification:** Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline. A relevant diploma may be considered based on institutional policy.
* **Experience:** Preferably 1–3 years in purchasing, procurement, inventory, hospitality, catering, or institutional food services.
* **Computer skills:** Working knowledge of MS Excel, email, purchase documentation, and inventory or ERP software.
* **Preferred knowledge:** Food-material procurement, vendor negotiation, stock control, invoice verification, and basic food-safety requirements.

**4. Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
* Vendor coordination and follow-up.
* Planning, organization, and time management.
* Cost-conscious decision-making.
* Integrity, accountability, and adherence to procurement policies.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with kitchen staff, store personnel, accounts, and administration.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The following indicators may be used for performance evaluation, with targets approved by management.

* **Purchase cost control:** Actual purchase expenditure against the approved budget.
* **Timely procurement:** Percentage of approved orders delivered on time.
* **Material availability:** Number of stockouts affecting cafeteria operations.
* **Purchase documentation:** Accuracy and completeness of purchase records.
* **Supplier performance:** Quality, price competitiveness, and delivery reliability.
* **Purchase compliance:** Adherence to approval limits and procurement procedures.
* **Wastage reduction:** Reduction in losses caused by over-purchasing, spoilage, and expiry.
* **Invoice accuracy:** Percentage of invoices processed without discrepancies.

**6. Authority and Accountability**

* May obtain quotations and negotiate prices within the authority delegated by management.
* May recommend vendors and purchase quantities for approval.
* Must not exceed approved purchase limits or bypass required approvals.
* Must disclose any potential conflict of interest with suppliers.
* Is accountable for purchase records, vendor coordination, cost monitoring, and compliance with institutional procedures.

**7. Internal Coordination**

The Purchase Executive shall coordinate with:

* Chef / Head Cook
* Storekeeper cum Kitchen Incharge
* Accounts Department
* HR & Admin
* Approved suppliers and vendors

**8. General Conditions**

* All purchases must comply with college procurement policies and approved budgets.
* Emergency purchases must follow the institution's emergency approval procedure.
* Supplier selection must be fair, transparent, and properly documented.
* Confidential commercial information must be handled appropriately.
* All applicable food-safety, hygiene, and storage requirements must be followed.
