title: ZScaler Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Zscaler administrator you are responsible for managing and configuring Zscaler security services, including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), to ensure secure network access for users by implementing and maintaining policies like URL filtering, threat prevention, and access controls, while also monitoring for security incidents and collaborating with network and security teams to optimize the Zscaler platform within an organization's infrastructure; essentially acting as the primary point of contact for all Zscaler related operations and troubleshooting.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Manage user and machines access to ZPA
* Manage IdP configurations/ Administrators/ Configure App Connectors
* Maintain User Portal and Browser Access to applications
* Maintain ZPA policies (Access, Timeout, Client Forwarding, Isolation)
* Manage ZIA authentication settings/ IdP configurations/ Administrators
* Maintain hosted pac files/ URL categories/ Certificates
* Configure and maintain SSL Inspection policies
* Configure and maintain URL & Cloud App Control policies
* Configure and maintain File Type Control policies
* Manage ZDX “Standard”
Support Mobile Connector Portal  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**  
  

* 6+ years of experience focused on network support, configuration, and implementation
* 6+ years of experience in core switching, routing, MPLS, and firewalls
* Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains
* Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision

  
**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**  
  

* Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) deployment and data center experience
* Experience with design and implementing Software Defined Network (SDN) and large complex networks
* Experience with protocols and technologies such as, BDP, OSPF, MP-FBP EVPN, VXLAN, or VPC

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

The role involves comprehensive responsibilities pivotal to the development and procurement of high-voltage components for Electric and Automated Tractors within the farm division. Key deliverables include:

* Identification and evaluation of potential suppliers capable of meeting the demanding specifications for EV and automated tractor components, ensuring alignment with technical and commercial expectations.
* Issuing Request for Quotations (RFQ), meticulously gathering and analyzing supplier quotes to support cost-effective decision-making.
* Conducting detailed Statement of Requirements (SOR) feasibility studies, engaging in initial technical discussions with suppliers specifically related to high-voltage parts such as motors, battery packs, DC-DC converters, thermal management systems, GNSS modules, HV chargers, and HV cables.
* Performing thorough costing exercises aimed at ensuring competitive pricing without compromising quality or performance.
* Developing a comprehensive supplier-part matrix that statistically synthesizes technical and commercial data to aid in strategic sourcing decisions and submission of detailed quote syntheses.
* Leading the development of components through structured process planning, including the identification and execution of required First Time Goal (FTG) activities to validate process readiness and quality standards.
* Establishing and proving out assembly lines at supplier sites, ensuring manufacturing processes meet stringent quality and output benchmarks.
* Monitoring and controlling the Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Vehicle Production Part Approval Process (VPPAP), ensuring compliance with industry standards and successful product validation.
* Creating and maintaining Management Information Systems (MIS) for real-time tracking of project progress, key milestones, timelines, and issue resolution, thereby facilitating transparent communication across all stakeholders.

**Experience**
--------------

Candidates should possess substantial industry experience ranging from five to ten years, exhibiting a proven track record in supply chain management, sourcing of electric vehicle components, and cross-functional project coordination within automotive or tractor manufacturing sectors. Prior exposure to high-voltage electrical systems or advanced powertrain technologies is highly advantageous. Experience working with multidisciplinary teams, managing vendor relationships, and overseeing process implementation and quality assurance initiatives is essential. Proficiency in leveraging data analytics to inform supplier evaluations and cost optimization strategies is expected to ensure successful project delivery.

**Industry Preferred**

Preferred industry backgrounds include Tier 1 Automotive Suppliers and Tractor Manufacturing sectors, especially those engaged in the electrification of vehicle platforms and advanced powertrain development. Professionals with experience in organizations specialising in Electric Vehicle (EV) component integration, battery management systems, and automated agricultural machinery will find this role aligned with their expertise. Familiarity with stringent automotive quality standards and familiarity with global regulatory frameworks within these industries will be highly valued.

**Qualifications**

Applicants are expected to hold a Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering or a closely related field. Additional certifications or training related to automotive engineering, electric vehicle technologies, or supply chain management will be considered a distinct advantage. A robust foundation in electronics principles, coupled with knowledge of high-voltage powertrain systems, thermal management, and control systems, is critical to support the technical demands of the role. Candidates demonstrating continuous professional development and dedication to staying abreast of emerging trends in EV technologies will be ideally suited.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong capabilities in the following general requirements:

* Competency in performing feasibility studies on Statements of Requirements (SOR) and leading technical discussions to achieve sign-offs on design and functional specifications.
* Expertise in techno-commercial analysis including Standard Bid Comparisons (SBC) and quote synthesis to support strategic supplier selection.
* Proven project management skills, with the ability to adhere to and manage strict timelines and deliverables efficiently.
* Analytical prowess for problem-solving, coupled with the capacity to interpret complex technical and financial data.
* Experience coordinating diverse cross-functional teams to drive collaboration and achieve project milestones.
* Proficiency in MS Office suite for documentation, reporting, and communication purposes.
* Commitment to driving project goals related to cost control, quality standards, and delivery timelines in line with the overall project plan.
* Technical knowledge encompassing electric vehicle powertrain components such as batteries, electric motors, and control units, alongside familiarity with automotive compliance and safety regulations.
* Understanding of thermal management solutions critical to EV component performance and safety.
* Experience with supplier panel development and validation of bill of materials (VOB).
* Working knowledge of commodity parts and manufacturing processes relevant to the automotive and agricultural machinery sectors.

title: Mainframe Storage Administration
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Enterprise storage support · Customer facing technical meetings and solution discussions · Opening and managing IBM PMRs for storage related issues · Supporting hardware/software upgrades, migrations, and resiliency projects · Spreadsheet/report creation for operational insight, trending, and capacity planning · Participation in capacity & growth management and performance tuning initiatives · Proficient with customer specific tools, utilities, and reporting frameworks
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**

  

* 8+ years of experience in Mainframe Storage Administration and GDPS environments.
* Strong expertise in GDPS administration, including Global Mirror replication monitoring, maintenance, and 4-site configurations.
* Experience with Cyber Resiliency technologies, including CSM, Thin Provisioning, Safeguarded Copy, and Cyber Vault operations.
* Advanced DFSMShsm (HSM) administration, troubleshooting, tuning, and performance optimization.
* Strong JCL development, troubleshooting, and diagnostic skills.
* Experience with REXX and SAS programming/scripting.
* Hands-on experience with storage utilities such as ICKDSF, DFDSS, FDR, DSCLI, and TDMF.
* Strong knowledge of SMS administration, including design, debugging, and ACS routine management.
* Experience with tape and catalog management, including RMM and ICF Catalog administration, monitoring, consolidation, reorganization, and recovery.
* Knowledge of performance and storage management tools such as Syncsort, StopX37, SEA Soft, and Dino Software tools.
* Expertise in IBM replication technologies, including PPRC, Metro Mirror, Global Mirror, and HyperSwap failover/failback.
* Experience with FlashCopy and point-in-time recovery solutions.
* Strong understanding of Disaster Recovery planning, execution, testing, and RPO compliance monitoring.
* Experience with large-scale enterprise HSM environments, backup management, dump processing, migration tuning, and ML1/ML2 optimization.
* Expertise in dataset recovery, catalog validation, and troubleshooting.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.  

  

### **Preferred Experience**

  

* Experience managing IBM TS7700 4-Grid Virtual Tape environments, including performance monitoring and utilization analysis.
* Strong knowledge of IBM DS8000 storage systems, including configuration, migration, capacity planning, and health monitoring.
* Experience using both DSCLI and GUI-based storage management tools.
* Knowledge of high-availability, replication, and business continuity solutions.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale storage migrations and modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with storage automation, monitoring, and capacity management tools.
* Ability to work effectively in critical production environments and manage high-priority incidents.
Strong collaboration skills with infrastructure, storage, application, and disaster recovery teams to ensure operational excellence and business continuity.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BV Enterprise | Vignesh Loans is looking for a proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented Office Administrator & Customer Support Executive. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for clients walking into our office or contacting us via phone and WhatsApp.

You will manage daily office administration, customer attending, document filing, customer KYC verification, and accurate system data entry into our internal software and Excel spreadsheets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. CUSTOMER SUPPORT & FRONT OFFICE DESK

- Welcome walk-in clients with a professional and helpful attitude.

- Understand customer loan inquiries and provide clear, accurate guidance on application steps and required paperwork.

- Manage incoming and outgoing office phone calls promptly and courteously.

2. SYSTEM DATA ENTRY & RECORD MAINTENANCE

- Enter borrower information, loan application forms, and customer KYC details accurately into internal systems, CRM software, and Excel/Google Sheets.

- Maintain and update daily registers for walk-in visitors, customer inquiries, leads, and document collections.

- Track customer repayment logs, billing records, and service charges with zero data entry errors.

- Regularly back up operational spreadsheets and cross-verify digital records against hard-copy paperwork.

3. DOCUMENT VERIFICATION, KYC & SYSTEMATIC FILING

- Receive, check, scan, and photocopy necessary borrower documentation (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Income Proofs, Bank Statements, Property Papers, etc.).

- Verify that submitted copies are legible, complete, and properly signed/attested by the customer.

- Create and maintain a well-organized physical filing cabinet with designated folders for active, approved, pending, and closed files.

- Digitize physical documents and upload them securely into designated cloud folders (Google Drive/internal portal).

- Ensure strict confidentiality and data protection of all client personal and financial information.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Performance Marketer**

**Company:** GroMatrix

**Department:** Performance Marketing

**Location:** Hosur Employment

**Type:** Full-Time Work

**Mode:** On-site

**About the Role**

GroMatrix is looking for a **performance marketer** to plan, launch, monitor, and optimize paid digital campaigns across client accounts.

You will work across platforms such as **Meta Ads and Google Ads** and collaborate with our Growth Strategy, Creative, Web/CRO, CRM & Automation, and Growth Intelligence teams.

This role is not simply about launching advertisements.

Your responsibility is to understand how advertising spend moves through the complete funnel:

**Ad → Click → Lead → Qualified Lead → Conversion → Revenue**

and continuously improve that performance.

**What You Will Own**

Your primary ownership will be:

**Paid Media + Campaign Execution + Budget Management + Performance Monitoring + Optimization + Testing + Scaling**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan paid advertising campaigns based on approved marketing strategy.
* Set up and manage Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Configure audiences, budgets, campaigns, and conversion objectives.
* Conduct campaign readiness checks before launch.
* Ensure tracking and conversions are functioning correctly.
* Monitor campaign performance daily.
* Track spend, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS where relevant.
* Manage advertising budgets.
* Optimize campaigns based on performance data.
* Analyze audience performance.
* Analyze keyword and search term performance.
* Monitor lead quality.
* Identify campaign and funnel issues.
* Conduct A/B testing.
* Test different audiences, creatives, offers, and formats.
* Identify creative fatigue.
* Coordinate new creative requirements with the Creative team.
* Coordinate landing-page improvements with Web & CRO.
* Coordinate lead flow and attribution requirements with CRM & Automation.
* Work with Sales / Revenue Operations to understand lead quality and sales conversion.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Recommend when campaigns should be optimized, paused, or scaled.

**Campaign Flow**

You will help manage:

**Campaign Objective**

↓

**Audience + Offer**

↓

**Creative**

↓

**Landing Page / Lead Form**

↓

**Tracking**

↓

**Campaign Launch**

↓

**Performance Monitoring**

↓

**Conversion Analysis**

↓

**Optimization**

↓

**Testing**

↓

**Scaling**

**Paid Platforms**

Depending on client requirements, you may work with:

* Meta Ads
* Google Search Ads
* Google Performance Max
* YouTube Ads
* Display / Remarketing
* LinkedIn Ads
* Other relevant advertising channels

**Performance & Funnel Thinking**

We expect the Performance Marketer to look beyond platform metrics.

For example:

A campaign generating cheap leads is not necessarily successful if those leads do not become qualified opportunities.

You should gradually understand:

**Ad Spend → Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Customer → Revenue**

and use this information to improve campaign quality.

**Creative Collaboration**

You will work closely with our creative lead and creative team.

You will provide information such as:

* Winning creatives
* Low-performing creatives
* Best-performing hooks
* Audience response
* Creative fatigue
* Required variations

This allows our creative team to produce stronger performance-focused assets.

**Conversion & Tracking**

You should be comfortable working with or understanding:

* Meta Pixel
* Google Ads conversions
* GA4
* UTM tracking
* Form conversions
* CRM lead flow
* Attribution

Technical implementation may be supported by our Web and Automation teams.

**Budget Management**

You will monitor:

* Daily spend
* Monthly spend
* Cost per result
* Budget utilization
* Campaign efficiency

You should be able to recommend where budgets should be:

**Reduced → Reallocated → Maintained → Scaled**

based on data.

**Testing & Optimization**

You should continuously look for opportunities to test:

* Audience
* Creative
* Copy
* Offer
* CTA
* Landing page
* Campaign structure

Testing should create learnings that improve future campaigns.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Strong with numbers and data.
* Comfortable managing advertising platforms.
* Analytical.
* Curious about customer behavior.
* Good at identifying performance problems.
* Comfortable working with budgets.
* Detail-oriented.
* Strong with campaign monitoring.
* Able to work with multiple teams.
* Interested in funnels, conversion, and business growth.

**Preferred Knowledge**

Experience or knowledge in:

* Meta Ads
* Google Ads
* Performance Marketing
* Paid Media
* Lead Generation
* Campaign Optimization
* Conversion Tracking
* GA4
* Google Tag Manager
* Funnel Analysis
* Landing Pages
* CRM
* A/B Testing
* Marketing Analytics

Experience managing lead-generation campaigns for service or B2B businesses will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Areas**

Your performance may be evaluated through:

* Campaign performance
* CPL / CPA
* Qualified lead quality
* Conversion rates
* Budget efficiency
* ROAS where applicable
* Campaign launch accuracy
* Tracking accuracy
* Optimization quality
* Testing
* Reporting
* Scaling decisions

**Who Will Fit This Role?**

You may be a strong fit if you naturally ask:

**Why did CPL increase?**

**Which audience actually converts?**

**Which creative is producing better leads?**

**Is tracking working correctly?**

**What happens after the lead enters CRM?**

**Where are users dropping from the funnel?**

**Should we optimize this campaign or stop it?**

**Is there enough data to scale?**

At GroMatrix, performance marketing is not just about **running ads**.

It is about turning **advertising investment into measurable acquisition, conversion, and revenue growth.**

You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and border less – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* Strong expertise in PowerShell advanced scripting, workflow automation, API integrations, and automation framework development.

* Knowledge of Cloud Platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Automation, Azure Arc, and hybrid cloud environments.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools including Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Git-based version control.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

title: Senior Engineer - ServiceNow
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**

* Configure and maintain core ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management to align with ITIL best practices
* Develop and maintain workflows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and notifications to automate and streamline service management processes
* Manage integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, and MID Servers — monitoring data flows and troubleshooting integration failures
* Collaborate with Solutions Engineering and Service Delivery teams to gather requirements, evaluate platform capabilities, and implement scalable configurations for client-facing and internal operations
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and Performance Analytics widgets to provide operational visibility into platform health, SLA compliance, and service delivery metrics
* Conduct regular platform health checks, audit user activity and role assignments, and ensure adherence to governance standards and compliance requirements
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of platform configurations, integration architectures, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks — supporting knowledge transfer across the platform team

**Technology/Area of Specialization:**

* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform administration across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, and Service Catalog modules — including instance management, update sets, and system properties configuration
* Familiarity with ServiceNow scripting and automation capabilities including JavaScript, GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, and Orchestration
* Familiarity with integration technologies including REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, LDAP, SSO/SAML, and Integration Hub for enterprise system connectivity

**Basic Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; ability to methodically diagnose platform issues, isolate root causes, and implement reliable fixes
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; ability to document technical configurations and explain platform capabilities to non-technical stakeholders
* Detail-oriented with a focus on configuration hygiene, update set discipline, and consistent adherence to platform governance standards
* Ability to manage competing priorities across platform operations, incident response, and project-driven configuration work
* Collaborative mindset with comfort working across distributed, cross-functional teams spanning multiple time zones
* Self-directed learning orientation — proactively tracks ServiceNow releases, new features, and community best practices to continuously improve platform operations

**Required Skills:**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow platform administration in an enterprise environment, preferably within IT services, managed services, or technology consulting
* Practical experience configuring ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Service Catalog) and working with CMDB, update sets, ACLs, and system administration tasks
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, GlideScript, REST/SOAP APIs, and MID Server administration; experience with Flow Designer or Orchestration preferred
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) preferred; ITIL 4 Foundation certification desirable; bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent hands-on experience

**Competencies Required:**

* Analytical Thinking
* Attention to Detail
* Initiative and Persistence
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Adaptability
* Continuous Learning

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

* Paid time off

title: Front Office Executive (Receptionist)
description:
Roles and Responsibilities – Front Office Executive

**1. Guest Handling & Customer Service**

* Welcome guests warmly and provide professional, courteous service.
* Handle guest enquiries, requests, complaints, and feedback promptly.
* Ensure a smooth and pleasant guest experience throughout the stay.

**2. Check-in and Check-out**

* Perform guest check-in and check-out procedures efficiently.
* Verify guest identification, reservations, and registration details.
* Allocate rooms according to availability and reservation requirements.
* Explain hotel facilities, services, policies, and timings to guests.

**3. Reservations & Room Management**

* Handle walk-in guests, telephone enquiries, and reservation requests.
* Coordinate room allocation, room changes, extensions, and special requests.
* Monitor room availability and update the Property Management System (PMS) accurately.
* Coordinate with Housekeeping regarding room status, readiness, and discrepancies.

**4. Billing & Cashiering**

* Prepare and settle guest bills accurately.
* Handle cash, card payments, and authorised payment methods.
* Maintain accurate records of transactions, advances, refunds, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure proper posting of room charges and other services to guest accounts.

**5. Telephone & Communication**

* Answer telephone calls professionally and transfer calls to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain accurate messages and ensure timely communication.
* Handle guest enquiries through telephone, email, and other approved communication channels.

**6. Coordination with Other Departments**

* Coordinate with Housekeeping for room readiness, cleaning, and maintenance issues.
* Liaise with Food & Beverage, Security, Maintenance, and other departments to fulfil guest requests.
* Inform the Front Office Manager or Duty Manager about operational issues and VIP arrivals.

**7. Records & Documentation**

* Maintain guest registration cards, arrival and departure reports, and other required records.
* Ensure accurate guest information and confidentiality of personal data.
* Complete shift handover reports and maintain proper documentation.
* Follow applicable statutory requirements for guest registration and foreign guest reporting.

**8. Upselling & Revenue Support**

* Promote room upgrades, hotel facilities, dining options, and other available services.
* Provide accurate information about room rates, packages, and promotional offers.
* Support occupancy, revenue, and guest satisfaction targets.

**9. Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Follow hotel SOPs, grooming standards, and service quality requirements.
* Protect guest belongings, room keys, access credentials, and confidential information.
* Report suspicious activities, emergencies, lost property, and safety concerns to the appropriate authority.
* Follow emergency procedures and applicable hotel policies.

**10. Additional Responsibilities**

* Attend departmental briefings, training sessions, and shift handovers.
* Maintain a clean, organised, and professional front desk.
* Perform other duties assigned by the Front Office Manager or management in accordance with hotel operations.
